methods.name: Multi-temporal image-composite change detection approach
methods.summary: A method implemented in Google Earth Engine that creates multi-temporal change detection image composites by reducing across all available images within one month before and after landslide events. It uses the mean of backscatter intensity for Sentinel-1 SAR data and maximum NDVI for Sentinel-2 to reduce noise and improve landslide visibility.
methods.verbatim: The GEE scripts are available on the following GitHub page: https://github.com/erin-ntnu/Change-detection-images-GEE (accessed 1 May 2022).
